preconditions.description: The number of gifts n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each gift's pleasantness a_i must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct gifts.

postconditions.description: If there is only one gift, output 'Impossible'.
Output the maximum sum of pleasantness if it is possible, otherwise output 'Impossible'.
